ops_hotel.speaker: ops
ops_hotel.text: Hi everybody, I'm in the car—

dev_q2.speaker: dev
dev_q2.text: Oh! Sorry—I actually have a rather important ques—

lead_hold.speaker: lead
lead_hold.text: Hold that thought, David, I wanna get to something first.

lead_wish.speaker: lead
lead_wish.text: For Q4, I want zero latency between product and engineering. I want us so close you can't tell where one ends and the other begins.

ops_love.speaker: ops
ops_love.text: Oh my god, I love that. That's so us!

lead_ci.speaker: lead
lead_ci.text: For starters—why does CI take four and a half days? Days, people!

lead_thats.speaker: lead
lead_thats.text: Holy shit, we're flying! What else is slow?

dev_skip.speaker: dev
dev_skip.text: I think it… deleted all the tests.

ops_slack.speaker: ops
ops_slack.text: Ha, yes—fuck Jira! …Wait, where'd Slack go?

lead_walls.speaker: lead
lead_walls.text: See? Tear down the walls between these teams—

eng_window.speaker: eng
eng_window.text: Marcus. Why is your window touching mine?

dev_tile.speaker: dev
dev_tile.text: Quick question—to your point, my skin is melting.

ops_beam.speaker: ops
ops_beam.text: Yes! Words are so slow—I wish we just shared a brain!

lead_voice.speaker: lead
lead_voice.text: Exactly! From now on, product and engineering speak with one voice.

eng_nono.speaker: eng
eng_nono.text: No! No no no—what is happening?!

lead_panic.speaker: lead
lead_panic.text: Stop it! STOP IT! Somebody stop it!

ops_hurts.speaker: ops
ops_hurts.text: Oh my god—it's pulling me in! Oh my god, it hurts!

dev_pituitary.speaker: dev
dev_pituitary.text: OH CRUMPETS! Oh bloody hell, it's pulling me in!

me_bye.speaker: me
me_bye.text: Nope. Good chat. I'll send notes.
